name: Academy Premise
entries: A school built inside a sleeping giant's ribcage, where the halls shift when the giant dreams.
A floating academy tethered to the ground by seven chains, each held by a different kingdom.
A school that appears for one year in every generation, and only invited students can find it.
A crumbling castle where the oldest wing is older than the hill it stands on.
A boarding school disguised as an ordinary town, with classrooms behind shopfronts.
A frontier academy training the first mages of a young colony, short on books and long on danger.
A school beneath a lake, lit by luminous fish and kept dry by a single stubborn ward.
An academy run by a council of retired adventurers who cannot agree on anything.
A school where every student is bound to a familiar before they are allowed to cast.
A prestigious academy whose examination hall is a pocket dimension nobody fully understands.
A school in a forest where the trees take attendance and the wolves grade essays.
A secret academy hidden in a travelling carnival that never visits the same town twice.
A school built on the ruins of an older school, whose basements are still in use.
An academy where magic is taught as a trade, with apprenticeships, unions, and contracts.
A school on a volcanic island where the forges are the classrooms and the lava is the clock.
A boarding school where the teachers are all ghosts and the headmistress is very much alive.
An academy that trains magical diplomats, where every lesson is a negotiation.
A school for late bloomers, where most students discover magic after they thought they had missed it.
A mountain academy reached by a single bridge that is only there in daylight.
A school where the library is larger than the building and nobody knows where it ends.

name: School Quirk
entries: The staircases change direction when someone is late.
Every portrait in the school has an opinion and only one of them is useful.
The bell tower rings a minute early when a secret is about to be told.
The school uniform changes colour with the wearer's mood.
There is a room that only appears to students who are avoiding someone.
The groundskeepers are a family of hobgoblins who have worked here longer than the school.
The library books reshelve themselves, sometimes in the wrong building.
The head teacher's chair is enchanted to make anyone sitting in it tell the truth.
A light rain falls indoors on the anniversary of the school's founding.
The school cat is the actual head of security and takes bribes in fish.
Every corridor has a different smell, and the smell tells you which floor you are on.
The school's wards hum a different note for each college.
The kitchens are staffed by a union of enchanted pots and one very tired cook.
A statue in the courtyard moves one step closer to the gates every year.
The school has no clocks, but everyone is somehow on time.
The oldest tree on the grounds grows a new ring whenever a student graduates.
There is a door that opens onto the same room in every building on campus.
The school's rules are posted in a language nobody teaches, and everyone understands them anyway.
The rain on the lake falls upward for one hour each month.
The academy has a second, secret timetable that only the prefects can read.

name: College Concept
entries: A college of builders and menders, known for practical magic and stubborn patience.
A college of watchers and record-keepers, who notice everything and say little.
A college of performers and liars, whose members are never quite where you last saw them.
A college of healers and gardeners, whose dormitory smells of herbs and wet earth.
A college of duellists and athletes, whose common room has a scoreboard older than the school.
A college of scholars and translators, who argue over footnotes at breakfast.
A college of explorers and mapmakers, whose members are rarely in their own beds.
A college of alchemists and cooks, whose experiments are either delicious or forbidden.
A college of diplomats and gossips, whose alliances change with the term.
A college of misfits and late bloomers, who take care of their own.
A college of wardens and guards, whose members take the school's safety personally.
A college of artists and illusionists, whose common room is never the same twice.
A college of beast-keepers and riders, whose dormitory has a stable attached.
A college of historians and relic-hunters, who know what the school buried and why.
A college of weather-workers and sailors, whose dormitory has its own tide chart.

name: Faculty Member
entries: A retired duellist who teaches defence and flinches at loud noises.
A brilliant theorist who has not left the library in three years.
A kindly alchemist whose sleeves are always slightly on fire.
A strict prefect-turned-teacher who remembers every rule and every exception.
A former court mage who will not say which court, or why they left.
A young teacher who is only a year ahead of the oldest students and knows it.
A groundskeeper who knows every tunnel and charges a favour for each one.
A visiting scholar who is definitely not here to steal something from the archive.
A cooking teacher whose potions and stews are difficult to tell apart.
A divination teacher who answers questions with better questions.
A healer who treats every injury as a personal insult.
A beast-keeping teacher with more scars than patience.
A music teacher whose songs can calm a room or crack a window.
A retired thief teaching locks and wards, and refusing to say which was which.
A head of college who plays favourites and is honest about it.

name: Student Clique
entries: The study circle that meets at dawn and shares notes only with its own.
The dormitory conspirators who know every loose floorboard in the school.
The sports team that treats every meal like a team talk.
The artists who decorate forbidden walls and sell the sketches.
The alchemy club whose meetings are officially about safety.
The rival first-years who compete over everything, including who is less competitive.
The older students who adopt lost first-years and terrify anyone who bothers them.
The quiet table in the library that is not as quiet as it looks.
The exchange students who know a different kind of magic and are tired of explaining it.
The troublemakers whose pranks are always a little too well planned.
The book club that reads banned books and argues about whether they count.
The creature keepers who smuggle something furry into the dormitory every term.
The duelling circle that meets in the old gym and keeps its own rankings.
The choir that can make a room feel like a different season.
The group that has decided the school's rules are a puzzle to be solved.

name: Class Challenge
entries: A practical lesson where the practice dummy has been replaced by something that answers back.
A treasure hunt through the school that is secretly a test of which rules you will break.
A potion that must be brewed before the hourglass empties and the ingredients stop arguing.
A creature escaped from the menagerie and hiding somewhere in the lesson hall.
A spell that works only if the caster tells the truth about why they want it.
A ward-building contest where the first team to break another team's ward wins.
A history lesson that turns into a ghost's argument about what really happened.
A garden that grows according to the gardener's mood and is currently very angry.
A duel lesson where the instructor has forbidden the obvious spell.
A translation exercise where the text keeps rewriting itself.
A cooking lesson where the stew is a credible potion and the potion is a credible stew.
A test of nerve in a room that shows each student their worst memory.
A mapmaking lesson in a corridor that is not on any map.
A lesson on familiars where the familiars have their own lesson planned.
A demonstration that goes wrong in a way the teacher has clearly seen before.

name: Exam Twist
entries: The exam is oral, and the examiner is a portrait that has been bribed.
The written paper has one question and three possible answers, all of them wrong.
The practical exam is a race, and the course changes while you run it.
The examiner is the school's oldest student, who is not supposed to be grading anyone.
The exam is open-book, but the book has been moved.
The questions are in a language the class has not been taught.
The exam is a group project, and the groups were chosen by the examiner.
The exam hall is under a silence spell that also stops writing.
The exam is a duel, and the winner's answers count for both students.
The examiner asks what you did last night, and means it.
The exam is a cooking contest, and the judges are the school's creatures.
The exam has a second part nobody warns you about.
The exam is a mock trial, and you are the defendant.
The examiner is a former student with a grudge.
The exam is a test of trust, and the examiner has arranged for someone to lie to you.

name: Magical Mishap
entries: The spell works, but everything within arm's reach now smells of lavender.
A second, smaller copy of the caster appears and is very confused.
The magic holds, but the caster's voice comes out an octave too high for a scene.
Every candle in the room relights whenever the caster blinks.
The target glows faintly for a day, making hiding difficult.
The spell leaves a trail of tiny footprints leading away from the caster.
A nearby object becomes convinced it is the caster and tries to help.
The caster's shadow starts acting on its own for a scene.
The magic works, but only while the caster is standing on one foot.
A harmless raincloud follows the caster indoors for an hour.
The spell's sound arrives a minute after the effect.
The caster swaps voices with the nearest person for a scene.
Everything the caster says for a minute comes out in rhyme.
The spell works, but leaves a mark on the caster's hand that fades over a day.
The magic attracts a small creature that is now determined to befriend the caster.

name: Campus Secret
entries: The school was founded on top of something that is still alive.
One of the colleges has a second common room nobody has been able to find for a century.
The head teacher is not the person the portraits remember.
The library has a shelf of books that are only visible to students who have broken a rule.
The lake is not a lake, but a very old spell waiting for a question.
A former student is still living in the walls and has been for years.
The school's charter has a clause nobody has read aloud since the founding.
One of the faculty is not human and the students have a betting pool on what they are.
The oldest tree on the grounds is a prisoner, not a tree.
The school's examination hall is a pocket dimension with a door that opens somewhere else.
A college's founding trophy is a fake, and the real one is missing.
The school's wards are powered by a bargain someone is still paying.
There is a class that appears on the timetable but has no teacher and no students.
The kitchens have a back door that leads to a city nobody can name.
The school's founder left a final lesson that has never been opened.

name: Festival or Tradition
entries: The Lantern Walk, when every student carries a light and the school tells its oldest story.
The Quiet Day, when no one may speak and all lessons are written.
The College Cup final, with a feast, a match, and a great deal of cheating.
The Founders' Debate, when students argue the school's oldest rules in front of the faculty.
The Night of Open Doors, when every locked room in the school is briefly unlocked.
The First Frost Feast, when the kitchens cook what the grounds grew.
The Exchange, when a rival school visits and everyone is on their best behaviour.
The Memory Market, when students trade stories instead of money.
The Long Lunch, when the timetable stops and the whole school eats outside.
The Warding Dance, when the students renew the school's smaller wards together.
The Day of Small Miracles, when students do favours for strangers and ask for none.
The Last Bell, when the graduating year walks out through the front gate and the school rings once for each.

name: Rival School
entries: A military academy that treats magic as a weapon and looks down on theory.
A floating school that has never landed and considers the ground a superstition.
A school of one teacher and a hundred apprentices, all of whom think they are the favourite.
A rival academy with better funding, worse manners, and a very good sports team.
A school that trains only healers and thinks everyone else is reckless.
A school that trains only duellists and thinks everyone else is soft.
A school hidden in a city, where magic is a trade secret and students are apprentices.
A school that accepts anyone and has the chaos to prove it.
A school with a strict uniform code and an illegal duelling league.
A school that has been feuding with the academy for so long nobody remembers why.
A school run by a family of mages who are all suspiciously charming.
A school that sends one exchange student every year and always chooses the most difficult one.

name: Magical Creature
entries: A paper-thin moth that eats handwriting and repeats what it has eaten in a whisper.
A small fox with two shadows, one of which is always doing something else.
A turtle whose shell is a working map of the school.
A cat that can walk through one wall a day and is very smug about it.
A bird that sings in the voices of people it has heard.
A beetle that polishes metal and expects payment in sugar.
A fish that swims through air for an hour after rain.
A large, gentle creature that eats weeds and sneezes sparks.
A spider that weaves words into its web instead of patterns.
A small dragon that has decided it is a dormitory pet and cannot be convinced otherwise.
A plant that grows a new leaf whenever someone tells it a secret.
A creature made of spilled ink that is trying very hard to be a person.

name: Academy Artifact
entries: A key that opens the last door you knocked on, not the one you are at.
A cup that refills with whatever the drinker last regretted saying.
A bell that rings when someone is about to break a promise.
A map that shows the school as it was a hundred years ago.
A quill that writes down what the writer is trying not to think.
A mirror that shows the room without any people in it.
A candle that burns longer when someone tells the truth.
A ring that grows warm near hidden writing.
A book that has a different last page each time it is opened.
A small statue that points at whoever is lying.
A cup that makes any drink taste like the drinker's childhood.
A bell that can be heard only by someone who is lost.

name: Research Prompt
entries: A spell that makes a small, specific thing easier for someone else.
A potion that lets two people share a sense for an hour.
An enchantment for a doorway or threshold that makes those who cross it remember who was kind in that room.
A spell that finds the shortest safe path, not the shortest path.
A potion that turns a bad memory into a bearable one without erasing it.
An enchantment for a container or lock that keeps one secret, and only one.
A spell that lets a caster borrow a skill for a moment and pay for it after.
A potion that makes a plant grow in the shape of a promise.
An enchantment for a token or bell that warns when a friend is in trouble, not when they are in danger.
A spell that translates a feeling into a sound.
A potion that lets someone speak to a creature that has no language.
An enchantment for a door or frame that remembers everyone who has opened it.

name: Adventure Hook: The School
entries: A first-year has disappeared, and the only clue is a door that was not there yesterday.
A teacher's demonstration has gone wrong, and the classroom is now somewhere else.
The College Cup points have been changed overnight, and nobody will admit to it.
A forbidden book has been checked out under a student's name, but the student is in the infirmary.
A statue in the courtyard has started giving advice that is too accurate.
The school's oldest bell has rung at midnight for three nights running.
A prefect is enforcing a rule that does not appear in any rulebook.
A student's familiar has begun delivering messages nobody wrote.
The kitchens have gone on strike, and the reason is more serious than the food.
A new teacher is teaching a subject that was not on the timetable.
A locked storeroom has been opened, and something small and valuable is missing.
A portrait has gone missing from its frame, and the frame is very upset.
A group of students has started a club that the faculty have forbidden by name.
The school's wards failed for exactly one minute, and someone used the minute well.
A letter from home arrives for a student who has no family.
The oldest student in the school has asked the player character for help.
A creature from the menagerie is living in the walls and has started a family.
An exam paper has been leaked, and the leak is more interesting than the exam.
A college's founding trophy has been stolen on the eve of the cup final.
A teacher has asked the player character to keep a secret from the rest of the faculty.

name: Adventure Hook: The Grounds
entries: A path that was not on the school map appears after a storm.
The lake has begun to freeze in a pattern that looks like writing.
A student has found a door in the old ruins that opens onto a room in the school.
The forest is closer to the grounds than it was last week.
A creature has been leaving gifts on the doorstep of the dormitory.
A gamekeeper's cache has been opened, and the contents are not what was stored.
The old bridge is repaired overnight, and nobody knows who did it.
A field that should be fallow is growing something nobody planted.
A student has been seen walking to the grounds after curfew and coming back with wet shoes.
The school's boundary stones have been moved, and the wards are unhappy about it.
A cave has opened in the hillside after a lesson went wrong.
A flock of birds has started following one particular student.
The grounds have a new path that leads to a place the school does not own.
A grave in the old cemetery has been opened from the inside.
A creature is nesting in the bell tower and refuses to leave.
A student has found a way off the grounds that the faculty do not know.
The lake has thrown up an object that belongs to the school's founding.
A winter storm is coming, and the school's weather wards are not ready.
A gardener has asked for help with a plant that has started talking.
A hidden garden has been found, and it is still tended by someone.

name: Adventure Hook: The People
entries: A rival has asked for help and will not say why.
A friend has been accused of something they probably did.
A teacher has offered extra credit for something that is clearly not coursework.
A college's leader is stepping down, and the election is already ugly.
A transfer student knows a spell nobody at the school has seen before.
A student's family has arrived to take them home, and the student does not want to go.
A prefect has been bribed to look the other way, and the bribe is cursed.
A faculty member has been seen arguing with someone who is not there.
A student has started a rumour that is more accurate than they know.
A friend has stopped speaking to the player character, and the reason is a secret.
A rival school's exchange student has a message for the player character.
A teacher's old adventuring party has come to visit, and one of them is not welcome.
A student has been offered a place in a secret society and does not know what to do.
A college is trying to recruit the player character and is being very obvious about it.
A student's pet has chosen the player character as its new favourite person.
A faculty member has asked the player character to spy on another faculty member.
A friend's older sibling has returned to the school with a dangerous idea.
A student has confessed to a prank they did not commit, and they will not say why.
A rival has challenged the player character to a duel with a secret stake.
A student has found a letter addressed to the player character and has not opened it.

name: Rumor
entries: The head teacher is leaving at the end of the year, and the replacement is already here.
The school is running out of money, and one college is expected to pay.
A student has been expelled, but their name is still on the dormitory door.
The library's restricted section is larger than the catalogue says.
A professor was a student here, and the old yearbooks have been removed.
The school's wards are older than the school, and they were not built for this place.
A creature in the lake has been fed every year and has never been seen.
One of the colleges is about to be dissolved.
The examination hall has a second door that only opens during exams.
A student has been seen in two places at once, and both of them were in trouble.
The kitchens are hiding a room that is not on the plans.
The school's founder is not dead, only sleeping somewhere under the grounds.
A teacher has been teaching the same lesson for twenty years because it is a spell.
The College Cup is rigged, and it always has been.
A former student has been living in the walls since before the current head teacher arrived.

name: Detention
entries: Polishing the portraits, which have opinions about technique.
Sorting the library's returned books, some of which do not want to be sorted.
Helping the groundskeeper with a task that is definitely not safe.
Writing lines with a quill that changes what you write if you are not paying attention.
Cleaning the practice dummies, which have been enchanted to complain.
Minding the youngest students during a lesson that has gone wrong elsewhere.
Cataloguing a box of donated artifacts, one of which is humming.
Assisting the cook, whose kitchen has strong views on students.
Mending the uniforms of the sports team, who will be in them again tomorrow.
Standing watch in a corridor that is cold for a reason nobody will explain.
Copying the school rules, which change slightly when the head teacher is annoyed.
Helping a teacher with a private experiment that is not on the curriculum.

name: Complication
entries: A teacher has noticed the player character is involved and wants to be kept informed.
The only student who can help is the one who is not speaking to them.
The school's rules say the right thing is also the punishable thing.
A time limit arrives earlier than expected.
The solution requires a favour someone is unwilling to spend.
A rival offers help, and the price is a public admission.
The evidence points at a friend.
The safest route is also the one that will be seen.
An adult who could fix it is away for the day.
The magic needed is forbidden, and the temptation is real.
Someone else is already trying to solve the same problem, badly.
The truth is less useful than the rumour and harder to prove.

name: Found Enchanted Object
entries: A brass hand-lantern with Everlight worked into the glass; it still burns, but the shutter sticks.
A folded map with Whispering on it; it names rooms that have been walled up for years.
A student's cloak with Self-Mending in the lining; it mends itself but not the rip in the college crest.
A coat pocket with Deep Storage; it holds one heavy book and makes the whole coat list to one side.
A small hand bell with Warning; it rings for someone who is no longer at the school.
A quill with Recall; it writes the last hour of a conversation in a hand that is not the owner's.
A pair of boots with Silence; the left boot is silent and the right one is not.
A plain ring with Small Favor; it works once a day, and the last wearer is still owed a favour.
A hand mirror with Delayed Reflection; it shows the room a breath late, including things that have already left.
A tin cup with Clean Water; it fills with water, but only when the drinker is not watching.
A locket with Warmth; it keeps the wearer warm, but grows cold near the old cemetery.
A compass with Homeward; it points at a house that burned down before the current students were born.
A travelling cloak with Camouflage; it blends into the woods but not into the school's stone halls.
A pair of spectacles with Close Detail; they show a hidden line of writing on the frame itself.
A music box with Calming; it plays one phrase, and the last person who wound it is missing.
